name: Dice Merge 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames

description: Dice Merge 3D is a dice match-3 puzzle game that is simple to play and highly addictive while offering a brain-boosting challenge.Combining domino-style mechanics with dice block puzzles, Dice Merge 3D delivers an engaging logic experience and a great IQ exercise suitable for players of all ages.
